consequence.statement: Compositions that leave spec.mode unset now default to Pipeline instead of Resources, so they are interpreted differently.
consequence.remediation: Set spec.mode explicitly (e.g. Resources) on Compositions that rely on the old default, or verify they work as Pipeline.

original.statement: The default of Composition spec.mode (apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1) changed from "Resources" to "Pipeline" for objects that leave it unset.

decision.reason: The change text (computed diff chg-a6808d027fcf), validator-confirmed against the compositions CRD artifacts [ev-b12db1ba30d3] [ev-a3bca45d2477], shows only that the v1 schema default of Composition spec.mode changed from "Resources" to "Pipeline" for objects that leave it unset. Those Compositions are now read as Pipeline instead of Resources. The upstream evidence never says they fail, are rejected or must be migrated, so behavior-change (review) is the supported kind and a failure kind would over-claim. Confidence is low because no release-note or upgrade-guide text is present, and the CRD excerpts do not show whether Resources mode still works in the target release.
